title: A VAX float is written in the format's own word order
description: 12.5 is 0.78125 × 2^4: exponent 128 + 4 = 132, fraction (0.78125 - 0.5) × 2^24 = 0x480000, the 32 bits 42 48 00 00, stored as two 16-bit words each least significant byte first: 48 42 00 00. 1.0 as D_floating is exponent 129 and a zero fraction, 40 80 then zeros, stored 80 40 00 00 00 00 00 00. A positive zero is all-zero bytes. The struct's byte order is not consulted.
